prior_layer_gate: Both persistent independent judges must accept every required artifact in the complete predecessor layer before dispatch.

producer_assignments.desktop-web: one isolated native producer reused for L2-L4
producer_assignments.app-session: existing correction producer reused for L2-L4, plus L4 entry
producer_assignments.design-tui: one isolated native producer reused for L2-L4

correction_policy: One bounded correction/reevaluation round per layer initially; replan any additional necessary correction visibly, never drop mandatory findings or replace judge veto.
reason: Three disjoint domain producers run concurrently after complete layer acceptance; same two tool-free judges review all units independently, preserving acceptance gates.
remaining_runtime_consumers: Execute only with compatible pinned actual runtime and real publication/binding; no substitute markdown reads. Frozen cases remain reserved from producers.
